sandboxIds.about: sha256 of the connect token as UTF-8, as hex, first 12 characters: the id every public hostname embeds, and the slug ic names a sandbox's container by when it has no public name. The contract's sandboxIdFromToken, sandbox-run's sandboxIdOfToken (Web Crypto) and ic's slug_from_token (util.rs) are each held to these. An empty token has no id in TS (undefined); ic refuses an empty CONNECT_TOKEN.

hostSshIds.about: sha256 of `<connect token>:<host name>` as UTF-8, first 12 hex: a deploy server's tunnel id (the contract's hostSshIdFromToken). connect-host.ps1 digests the same input the same way when a code's answer carries no HOST_ID. No PowerShell runs in the suites, so a test of the contract reads that script's source for the salted input and the cut; these vectors pin the TS half to the digest.

hostnameSlugs.about: The slug a hostname names a sandbox by: its first label, lowercased as DNS reads it, and none for an empty label. sandbox-run's slugOfHostname (TS) and ic's slug_of_hostname (util.rs, which connect.rs names a container by) are each held to these.
